entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-01
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Extension: foreach in nested method in new extension methods will cause a compiler exception #79212

Closed

  • CSS008 Missing a class name after the dot ('.') #79213

    Area-IDE
